user.description: Add Room Valve Control. Rooms are added to it afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Room Valve Control is already set up.

data_description.name: Name of the room and of its thermostat entity.
data_description.sensors: The room temperature is the mean of the sensors that have reported within the stale sensor timeout.
data_description.trvs: Eurotronic Spirit TRVs. Each TRV's valve control and temperature offset (parameter 8) entities must be enabled. A TRV can belong to one room only.
data_description.kp: Valve change in % points per °C of control error.
data_description.ti: Time in which the integral term adds as much as the proportional term at a constant error.
data_description.control_step: How often the valve position is computed.
data_description.min_change: A TRV is written only when the computed position differs from its valve reading by at least this many % points. Above {endpoint_tolerance} and at most {valve_max}.
data_description.stale_timeout: When no wall sensor has reported for this long, the TRVs regulate on their own.
data_description.min_target: Lowest target temperature the room thermostat accepts.
data_description.max_target: Highest target temperature the room thermostat accepts.

error.no_sensor: Select at least one wall temperature sensor.
error.sensor_not_registered: {sensor} has no unique ID, so the room could not find it again after a rename. Give it a unique ID or select another sensor.
error.trv_entity_missing: {trv} is not usable: its {entity} entity was not found. Only Eurotronic Spirit TRVs on Z-Wave JS are supported.
error.trv_entity_disabled: {trv} is not usable: its {entity} entity {entity_id} is disabled. Enable it and try again.
error.trv_no_device: {trv} is not usable: it belongs to no device. Only Eurotronic Spirit TRVs on Z-Wave JS are supported.
error.min_change_out_of_range: Must be above {endpoint_tolerance} and at most {valve_max} % points.
error.target_range_empty: Must be greater than the minimum target temperature.
